positive_snippets: Recently I had an opportunity to stay at this place. The rooms are good and the food excellent. Buffet at the basement is sumptuous and filling. Waiters and attendants are friendly and helpful. Location is a plus point with very near to Outer Ring Road. Would definitely recommend it.

I visited Delhi, it was late at night, many hotels didn't provide late night check in, so find this hotel on Google maps. Called them, they accepted checkin at 1 am.
Prices where average. Service was good. But rooms were bit unhygienic.
There were gutka shots on a was
Room size was average.
I would suggest try some online sites for better price

A wonderful and comfortable hotel with reasonably sized rooms. The hotel was great in every factor but the location had abundance of mosquitos. You won't be able to utter a word without tasting a mosquito which will have flown into your mouth.
Overall, the hotel rooms and service are legendary, but the breakfast was not too good.
negative_snippets:
Pathetic pathetic pathetic!
The hospitality of this place is so poor that I cannot even explain.
I kept a cake at the reception and asked the waiters to bring it when it was time.
The waiters never went and we were delusional that they will. I had to go after 20 mins to bring it myself.
Then I wanted to have coffee but the cups were over. I asked the waiter to bring me a cup. Not only did he not bring it. He closed thr machine saying that it is lunchtime. They could not even give me one cup of coffee.
Then I asked them to still give it to me.
That coffee never came.
Is that the kind of hospitality they show?

This was hands down the worst hotel experience I’ve ever had. Despite having a fully prepaid reservation, I was shockingly denied check-in simply because I’m an international traveler. This policy was never mentioned anywhere during the booking process, which makes it feel deceptive. The staff were unhelpful and dismissive, showing zero concern for the situation.

Not only was I left without a place to stay, but I also lost the full amount I paid—no refund, no apology, nothing. It’s incredibly frustrating, especially given how many positive reviews this hotel has on Trip.com. I can only assume some of them are misleading or not reflective of reality.

The customer service was appalling, and the management clearly doesn’t care about guest experience. I strongly urge others to avoid this hotel, especially international travelers. Don’t be fooled by the photos or the ratings online—what you see is definitely not what you get.
